# Research Landscape Report — Sample corpus (synthetic)

_Corpus: 8 papers, 2022–2025. Items marked *candidate* need human review._

## Executive summary

We study chain-of-thought prompting for multi-step agents on grade-school math problems. [p1:abstract:1] We introduce PlanAct, an agent that writes an explicit plan before taking web actions. [p2:abstract:1] We present SelfCritic, a loop in which a coding agent critiques and revises its own output. [p3:abstract:1] We replicate SelfCritic on two benchmarks and find the gains are small. [p4:abstract:1]

## Topics

- **memorygraph, tooltune, web** (3 papers: p5, p6, p8) — terms: memorygraph, tooltune, web, memory, graph
